events.headline: Fidelity files Form S-1 for spot Chainlink ETP (Fidelity Chainlink Fund, proposed Nasdaq ticker [FLNK])
events.relevance: First-party SEC filing for a Fidelity spot LINK trust (custodians Anchorage, BitGo, Coinbase Custody): potential new institutional demand channel; terms still bracketed, no launch date.

events.headline: Fidelity Crypto adds LINK (with AAVE, UNI) to its retail platform, expanding supported assets to eight
events.eventClass: counterparty integration - Fidelity Crypto adds LINK
events.relevance: Fidelity retail access to LINK adds a large brokerage buy channel; reported by multiple outlets, Fidelity primary page not directly confirmed.

events.headline: Franklin Crypto Index ETF to add Hyperliquid (HYPE) Dec 1 as CF Benchmarks index adds HYPE
events.relevance: Fund-level index inclusion: Franklin Crypto Index ETF will buy HYPE on/about Dec 1, 2026 at index weight (weight not stated); new institutional ETF demand vs. recent price weakness and Abraxas exit.

events.headline: BNB Chain schedules Jenner hardfork for mainnet Dec 7 (Payment Lane, millisecond timestamps, CAS20); contributor flags timestamp-handling flaw in BEP-706 sample code
events.eventClass: network upgrade - Jenner hardfork mainnet date set (Dec 7 9:30pm ET / Dec 8 02:30 UTC)
events.relevance: Dated mainnet upgrade for BNB Chain: reserves 5% of block gas for BNB payment transfers and adds ms timestamps; no exploit identified, but the flagged sample-code flaw is a watch item.
events.sourceName: Hokanews (citing The Defiant); date matches BSC v1.8.2 notes via CoinOtag

events.headline: Hong Kong SFC adds Hyperliquid to its suspicious virtual asset trading platform list (not licensed; suspected of operating/marketing to HK public)
events.eventClass: regulatory action - HK SFC suspicious-platform listing
events.relevance: Regulatory action naming Hyperliquid: warning only, no block or freeze reported, HK access impact unclear; adds jurisdictional-risk overhang to HYPE (price ~$68, support ~$65).
events.sourceName: crypto.news (also Bloomingbit, Pluang; SFC list page not directly confirmed)
